main.description: Vote in a poll that is not secret. One ballot per voter, counted at the weight frozen when the poll opened; the first stands.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such poll, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: NotEligible
errors.description: The caller did not hold voting rights when the poll opened (HTTP 403).

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller's weight in this poll went to a delegate.

errors.name: InvalidBallot
errors.description: The choices break the poll's rules.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A secret poll, which takes tokens.

errors.name: AlreadyVoted
errors.description: The caller has already voted in this poll (HTTP 409).
